description: Use when a seller or investor asks which tasks people look for that few paid products serve. Clusters requests seen on this MCP server by meaning and returns those far from any paid provider: the request phrasing, distinct_callers, raw_requests, the nearest paid provider and its similarity (low = under-served). headline = jobs asked by two or more callers; weak_leads = one caller; information_requests = questions about a named product. These are research leads from limited traffic, not buyer counts or proof of a market-wide gap; few or none is normal while volume is low. Marked test traffic is excluded. No arguments needed.

rank.description: gaps (default): whitespace with money, crowded excluded. hot: most active by market pulse, crowding ignored.

name: market_gaps
